groups.title: There is a place for you here.

groups.trainingText: In Jesus we see grace and truth in fullness. We grow by looking to Him.
groups.plenitudeText: Marriage, youth, health, and family — every part of life is explored in light of Scripture.

about.label: Get to know us
about.title: Rooted in Christ. Open to you.
about.text: We seek to be a healthy, biblical, spiritual, and multiplying church: reaching lives, reconciling people with God, forming disciples, and sending them to serve.

vision.label: Our vision
vision.title: Reach, strengthen, form, and send.
vision.text: Reaching homes to proclaim Jesus Christ, reconciling nonbelievers with God, and forming them as disciples who live and serve in the Holy Spirit.
vision.reachText: We bring Christ's love to every home.
vision.strengthenText: We accompany and strengthen people in faith and unity.
vision.formText: Disciples with mature service and strong character.
vision.sendText: We inspire people to impact the world with Christ's love.
vision.quote: “We live in God’s presence, walk in obedience, celebrate with joy and faith, love and care with integrity, welcome with hospitality, and serve with humility.”

pastors.heroTitle: A life dedicated to serving people and forming disciples.
pastors.heroText: Get to know the story, calling, and work that shape the pastoral heart of Iglesia Plenitud en Cristo.
pastors.marioBio1: Pastor Mario Alsina has more than three decades of ministry experience in theological education, church planting, pastoral care, and media outreach.
pastors.marioBio2: He is founder, rector, and professor at Global Harvest Theological Institute (GHTI), an institution created to offer accessible theological training and prepare servants for the mission of the church.
pastors.ghtiLink: Learn about Global Harvest Theological Institute →
pastors.journeyTitle: A ministry that connects the local church with formation and mission.
pastors.milestone1Text: A pastoral path marked by service to families, discipleship, and the planting of churches in Las Vegas.
pastors.milestone2Text: A Master of Theological Studies from Southwestern Baptist Theological Seminary, continuing doctoral studies, and other academic certifications.
pastors.milestone3Text: Founder and director of GHTI, expanding accessible theological education for students and ministry leaders.
pastors.milestone4Text: Author of "Sketches of the Gospel of John" and "Cómo perdonar de verdad," alongside ongoing teaching and leadership.
pastors.adrianaSubtitle: Worship, mission, and the next generation.
pastors.adrianaBio1: Adriana Alsina is a music teacher, worship leader, and co-founder of GHTI. Her ministry includes worship formation, church planting, and service to the community in Las Vegas.
pastors.adrianaBio2: With more than three decades of service in worship and church-planting ministries, she also teaches Theology of Worship and brings creativity through children's books and Christian songs.
pastors.value3: Care for families and the local community.
pastors.value4: Mission that sends people to serve.
pastors.ghtiTitle: Stories and moments from the mission.
pastors.ghtiText: We are preparing this space to share future photo updates from Global Harvest Online. Until then, you can follow their work on Instagram.

bibleModal.subtitle: A word for you
bibleModal.description: May the living word of God fill your heart with peace and renew your strength today.
bibleModal.noShow: Do not show these blessing messages again

verses.text: The Lord is near to all who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.
I can do all this through him who gives me strength.
The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing.
Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding.
For I know the plans I have for you, declares the Lord, plans to prosper you and not to harm you.
But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit.
